meta.title: Chat translate
meta.description: Rewrites assistant reply prose into natural Simplified Chinese, leaving code blocks and thinking chains untouched.

en.aiRule: This is the only channel: translation runs when Key, Base URL and model are all present; missing any one leaves the text as it is.
en.apiKeyDesc: Saved as {ref} in {home}; takes effect immediately. Saving an empty value clears it.
en.apiKeyPlaceholderConfigured: Configured (type a new value to replace it)
en.behaviorRule: All assistant reply prose, the final summary and Chinese-only blocks included: Chinese blocks are also handed to the model, which rewrites them into natural Chinese while keeping meaning, terms and numbers unchanged; blank blocks are never sent and never marked. Think-chain text, tool-call titles and folded summaries are never translated; code blocks and their contents stay untouched.
en.dockOff: Translation is off; click to turn it on
en.dockOn: Translation is on; click to turn it off
en.failTitleUnconfigured: The translation channel is not configured yet
en.invalidTimeout: Invalid timeout: enter a number of milliseconds between 500 and 900000
en.keyCleared: API Key cleared (with nothing configured, replies stay in their original language)
en.masterDesc: Automatically translates assistant reply prose (e.g. {example}) into Chinese: text inside disclosure blocks and the final summary are treated alike, and blocks written entirely in Chinese go through the model too, which rewrites them into natural Chinese and smooths out machine-flavored phrasing. Think cards and tool-call rows are never translated, and code blocks stay untouched. Prose keeps the host's own layout u2014 nothing is drawn at its left edge. Switching does not live on the prose: a transparent slim strip hugging its left edge is the control u2014 the pointer turns into a hand over it, and one click swaps translation and original, another swaps back, while the prose itself never reacts to clicks, so selecting or drag-copying text never triggers a swap by accident. A reply the model returned unchanged still counts as translated and stays switchable. When a block fails to translate it stays in its original language with a small u21BB left beside it: hover that button for the channel detail (a timeout, a broken stream or an empty return), click it to re-run the whole row, and while it waits the icon spins in place and cannot be clicked again; blocks that already succeeded stay on screen undisturbed. Channel failures are never retried automatically: once the channel recovers, a click on u21BB revives the row. Translations are re-rendered as Markdown, so tables, lists, bold runs and inline code keep their structure. A reply that is still streaming is left alone until it settles, then prose turns to Chinese paragraph by paragraph in reading order. Applies to the session you are viewing only; translations never enter the conversation context. The same switch sits on the row below the composer, sharing its state.
en.modelDesc: e.g. {model1} or {model2}; empty counts as unconfigured
en.retryAria: Translation failed u2014 press this button to translate this block again
en.retryAriaUnconfigured: The translation channel is not configured yet: fill in the API Key, Base URL and model on the Plugins page, then press this button to retry
en.saveProbeFail: Settings saved, but the channel probe failed: {error}
en.timeoutDesc: In milliseconds, range 500-900000. One long reply can take minutes; default 600000.
en.unsavedHint: Changes take effect after you save
